description: This file defines the AdHocWritePlatformService interface in Java, specifying methods for creating, updating, deleting, disabling, and enabling ad-hoc queries within the Apache Fineract system.

methods.name: createAdHocQuery
methods.description: Creates a new ad-hoc query with the provided command.

methods.name: updateAdHocQuery
methods.description: Updates an existing ad-hoc query identified by adHocId with the provided command.

methods.name: deleteAdHocQuery
methods.description: Deletes the ad-hoc query identified by adHocId.

methods.name: disableAdHocQuery
methods.description: Disables the ad-hoc query identified by adHocId.

methods.name: enableAdHocQuery
methods.description: Enables the ad-hoc query identified by adHocId.
